observations.why: Directive issued as a standing order — positional authority setting an ongoing cadence by fiat.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic equivalence claim supplies a factual frame — rehearsed equals real — to justify the cadence; logic and information control co-occur.
Formalized record of the cadence decision — positional authority codifying a standing order into a durable artifact.
Assigning ownership by name is an exercise of positional authority — the owner is accountable to the directive's issuer.
